breakpoints.note: The staged witness is admitted far enough that the top-level Variant resolves `Type == 22` and dispatches its `Body` field through `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject()` instead of being rejected before the vulnerable helper runs.

The attacker-controlled top-level `"Type":22` field is resolved through `UA_findDataType()` to the built-in `ExtensionObject` type and stored in `dst->type`, which is the dispatch state that sends the Variant body into the vulnerable unwrap helper.

Error cleanup frees the allocated unwrapped body buffer but does not clear `dst->data`. The fixing commit adds `dst->data = NULL;` immediately after this free, so the later `UA_deleteMembers()` / `Variant_clear()` cleanup on the same partially built Variant no longer frees the same pointer again.
